name: Benjamin Pringle

residences.place: Plymouth Twp ('Benjn Pringle', head aged 50-60, a few households above Saml and James Pringle)

bioAdditions: In the 1840 census of Plymouth Twp, 'Benjn Pringle' heads a household of about ten, a few lines above Saml Pringle and James Pringle (S2). The age column for the head reads 50-60, which is older than his 1794 birth date suggests. FamilySearch attaches a Minnesota death record of his daughter Bethia (Pringle) Roberts naming 'Benj. Pringle' as her father, which extends the 'Bethia, Iowa' line in the existing bio, and gives his burial at Larksville (S1).
